ui_tip.jaymospowers.body.title: Your body
ui_tip.jaymospowers.body: Left of your hotbar: your stomach, your stance, your wounds and your body heat. Sneak and scroll to change stance. %1$s opens the full picture.
ui_tip.jaymospowers.right.title: Right of your hotbar
ui_tip.jaymospowers.right: Your power, the beast you ride and anything you have running show here.
ui_tip.jaymospowers.crosshair.title: Around your crosshair
ui_tip.jaymospowers.crosshair: Charge bars and the eye that says you've been seen sit above it. Guard, finishers and work bars sit under it. Combos and readings sit to its right.
ui_tip.jaymospowers.focus.title: Over your hotbar
ui_tip.jaymospowers.focus: Struggles, your forms belt and what spirits say show here, just above the hotbar.
ui_tip.jaymospowers.rail.title: Top left
ui_tip.jaymospowers.rail: Under the map: your power, kin you can sense, your party and what your keys do right now.
ui_tip.jaymospowers.move.title: Move it
ui_tip.jaymospowers.move: Something in the way? Type /hudmove to drag any part of the HUD. Right-click a part to put it back.
ui_tip.jaymospowers.menu.title: Character menu
ui_tip.jaymospowers.menu: Every page is grouped under You, Powers, World, People and Notices. Missed tips wait under Notices.
ui_tip.jaymospowers.journal.title: Your journal
ui_tip.jaymospowers.journal: Press %1$s to open it: your quests, the places you know and the people you've met.
